final.report:
DELPHI's validate_generation compared the generated design "ff-zf-chimera" against the base "zebrafish-adult". Both were supplied as repository design ids. The desired phenotype was "a zebrafish-flying-fish chimera that glides at least 10 m from a 1 m launch and tolerates 18-28 C as an adult". It parsed into three hard adult-stage criteria: glide_range_total_m >= 10 m from a 1 m launch, and survival at 18 C and at 28 C. Nothing was left unparsed or refused. The parser noted that no editable parameters were stated, so an optimizer would have nothing to vary.

The verdict is that the word "validated" is withheld. The reasons are that 4 gates could not be assessed, 3 biological scales could not be assessed, and no sequence was compared at any locus. This is not a validity claim.

The five results, reported separately:
- Genotype similarity: cannot-assess. The design carries no gene-level edit, so no sequence was assessed and 0 loci were covered. The differences from the base are morphological parameter deltas, which have no allele to score. This is not a pass.
- Phenotype similarity: pass. The body is inside the calibrated shape distribution (p 0.2649). This is shape similarity to real specimens, not relatedness, and it says nothing about features the comparison does not read.
- Lean check: cannot-assess. No Lean law could be evaluated (23 cannot-evaluate, 12 out of scope). No accepted-law violation was found, but that is not a pass.
- Functional resolution: cannot-assess. The ledger of differences is empty, which is not evidence that there are none.
- Physics check: cannot-assess. The glide criterion (glide_range_total_m) has no model and was not checked, so 1 of 3 hard criteria is uncovered. A standing check also failed, and it is reported beside the gate rather than folded into it. Only 84.7% of the requested flight-muscle volume fits inside the skin. The other 15.3% has nowhere to go, so any power claim that charges the full muscle mass is unphysical.

Scales not assessed: cell, tissue and organ_system. The organ and body scales were assessable.

The scorer's composite number (0.8449) is carried through for reference only. No gate feeds it and it is not the outcome.
